integrity: The universal formula is proved analytically from the exact neighborhood-union condition and a complete low-weight case classification. The standalone checker independently exhausts all labelings for crown graphs of orders 6 through 12 vertices.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to crown graphs with n at least 3. It does not give an all-function formula for arbitrary matching-deleted bicliques or general bipartite graphs; finite computation is only a stress test.
title: Vertex–edge Roman \(\{2\}\) weight enumerator of crown graphs
